text: Which polynomial does Eisenstein's criterion with p = 3 show to be irreducible over ℚ?
explanation: Eisenstein at p needs: p ∤ leading coefficient, p | every other coefficient, and p² ∤ constant term. For x⁵+9x+3: 3∤1, 3|9, 3|3, 9∤3 — all satisfied. The others fail: 9 | 9 breaks the p² condition, and 3 ∤ 1 breaks the middle condition in the last two.
